en.headline: Observatory records 34.7°C, hottest day of the year so far
en.dek: Under the influence of Severe Typhoon Dolphin’s outer subsiding air, temperatures exceeded 38 degrees in parts of the New Territories while the headquarters logged its highest reading of 2026.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory recorded a maximum temperature of 34.7 degrees Celsius at its headquarters by late afternoon on Saturday, the highest so far this year, as extremely hot conditions continued under the influence of Severe Typhoon Dolphin.

The Observatory said the typhoon’s outer subsiding airstream was bringing prolonged extreme heat to Guangdong and Hong Kong. Temperatures in many districts rose above 35 degrees, with Sheung Shui reaching about 38.5 degrees and other New Territories locations also exceeding 37 degrees.

A Very Hot Weather Warning remained in force, and the Observatory warned that extreme heat would persist through Sunday and into early next week, with some areas expected to reach 37 degrees or above. The Labour Department’s Yellow Working Heat Stress Warning was later cancelled in the evening.

zh.headline: 天文台錄34.7度創今年最高 上水高見38.5度
zh.dek: 受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，本港極端酷熱，天文台總部錄得今年最高氣溫，新界多區超過37度。
body: 香港天文台表示，周六下午本港多處氣溫升至35度或以上，截至下午4時總部錄得最高氣溫34.7度，是今年以來最高紀錄。
受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，極端酷熱天氣持續。上水錄得約38.5度，元朗公園及山頂等地亦超過37度。酷熱天氣警告繼續生效。
天文台指出，未來一兩日高溫持續，部分地區可達37度或以上，下周中期酷熱天氣仍會維持。勞工處其後於晚間取消黃色工作暑熱警告。市民應多補充水分及採取防暑措施。
